title: Monochrome
description: Adds a monochrome biome with building blocks
body:
Monochrome is a building/decoration mod that adds monochrome wood to Minecraft.
If you wanted to build with black and white blocks, this is going to be your
new favorite building mod!

I recommend using this with fast graphics. I couldn’t get the leaves to work
in fancy-style graphics.

For anyone wondering, the mod's icon is very similar to the acacia log texture.
I would tint it darker, but it wont be monochrome that way

Thanks for avno2020 on discord for giving me the idea.
